title: CRISPR screens identify genes essential for in vivo virulence among proteins of hyperLOPIT-unassigned subcellular localization in Toxoplasma
model: Toxoplasma gondii RH, Unassigned_1 gRNA library (295 genes, 2,944 guides)
contrast: In vivo (10 mice) vs in vitro P4 reference, depletion; median-ratio totals
paper_method: Median log2FC fitness score, Wilcoxon rank-sum per gene, ranked by distance from regression line
paper_calls: Named/validated in vivo virulence genes (TgGTPase, GLT2, VIT, DDI1, Trx4, Nudix, Caax, AAMT, mRNACF, TGGT1_211850)
barcs_calls: 198 genes at FDR 0.10 (185 at 0.05); no control null (no non-targeting guides)
verdict: BARCS recovers all ten in vivo virulence genes the paper names or validated within its top 29 (nine in the top 18), with ROP18 and GRA23 controls also ranking high; the ten mice give 9 residual df so the standard model applies, though the single in vitro reference is unreplicated and the bottlenecked libraries require median-ratio totals.
